response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL THEN spent END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL THEN amount END), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM r) AS relative_ratio FROM r ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
